mythic_age.spellbook.lightning_storm.des: Summon Zeus's divine thunder, raining destructive lightning upon the target area.
mythic_age.spellbook.restoration.descrip: Athena's healing power, restoring health to yourself and nearby allies.
mythic_age.spellbook.lure.description: Poseidon's calling power, attracting nearby wild animals to gather.
mythic_age.spellbook.underworld_army.des: Hades' undead legion, summoning skeleton warriors from the underworld to aid in battle.
mythic_age.spellbook.pestilence.descript: Ares' plague of war, weakening enemies with disease and suffering.
mythic_age.spellbook.curse.description: Aphrodite's transformative curse, turning wounded enemies into harmless pigs.
mythic_age.spellbook.earthquake.descript: Artemis' earth-shaking power, devastating buildings and terrain in a wide area.
mythic_age.spellbook.ceasefire.descripti: Hermes' peaceful intervention, temporarily halting all combat in the area.
mythic_age.spellbook.bronze.description: Dionysus' divine armor, granting enhanced protection and strength to allies.
Apollo's mystical gateway, instantly transporting the caster through the underworld.
mythic_age.spellbook.lightning_storm_her: Hera's supreme thunder, unleashing a more powerful lightning storm than Zeus himself.
mythic_age.spellbook.plenty.description: Hephaestus' divine forge, constructing a magical altar that periodically generates resources.
mythic_age.spellbook.rain_prayer.descrip: Call for dragon rain to nourish dry land, accelerate crops, and calm fire.
Invoke the earth god's favor, enriching nearby soil and strengthening harvest work.
mythic_age.spellbook.enlightenment.descr: A beam of wisdom opens the mind, increasing experience and learning momentum.
mythic_age.spellbook.abundance.descripti: Bless nearby crops with sudden growth, turning patient farming into a fast harvest.
mythic_age.spellbook.five_thunder.descri: Summon five righteous thunderbolts to strike enemies with overwhelming force.
mythic_age.spellbook.crane_blessing.desc: A celestial crane grants healing, protection, and brief aerial grace.
mythic_age.spellbook.flood.description: Release a sweeping flood that washes through enemies and terrain.
mythic_age.spellbook.call_to_arms.descri: Summon guardian allies to defend the caster and press the attack.
mythic_age.spellbook.taiji_shield.descri: Shape yin-yang force into a protective shield that resists incoming harm.
mythic_age.spellbook.recreation.descript: Use Nuwa's creative power to restore and reshape damaged ground.
mythic_age.spellbook.fenrir_howl.descrip: Fenrir's terrible howl terrifies enemies and calls wolves to battle.
mythic_age.spellbook.odin_eye.descriptio: Open Odin's all-seeing eye to reveal hidden threats and tactical knowledge.
mythic_age.spellbook.great_hunt.descript: Call hunting eagles from the sky to strike ground targets.
mythic_age.spellbook.dwarven_mine.descri: Raise a secret dwarven mine rich with stone, ore, and mining blessings.
mythic_age.spellbook.thor_wrath.descript: Unleash Thor's hammering storm with thunder, lightning, and impact.
mythic_age.spellbook.valhalla_call.descr: Open the gates of Valhalla and call heroic warriors to fight beside you.
mythic_age.spellbook.frost.description: Bring Jotunheim's cold to freeze ground, slow enemies, and bite with ice.
mythic_age.spellbook.walking_woods.descr: Wake the old forest so trees rise and defend the land.
mythic_age.spellbook.ragnarok.descriptio: Invoke apocalyptic ruin, shaking the battlefield with end-times force.
mythic_age.spellbook.fimbulwinter.descri: Summon the endless winter, blanketing the battlefield in killing cold.
mythic_age.spellbook.ra_radiance.descrip: Ra's sunlight drives back darkness, heals allies, and burns the undead.
mythic_age.spellbook.desert_storm.descri: Set's desert storm blinds, slows, and wears down enemies in sand.
mythic_age.spellbook.sun_rain.descriptio: Golden rain falls beneath the sun, healing allies and cleansing the ground.
mythic_age.spellbook.prosperity.descript: Hathor's prosperity blesses trade, luck, and resource gathering.
mythic_age.spellbook.eye_of_horus.descri: The Eye of Horus reveals enemy positions, weakness, and hidden value.
mythic_age.spellbook.anubis_judgment.des: Anubis weighs the battlefield and marks enemies for deathly punishment.
mythic_age.spellbook.locust_swarm.descri: A devouring locust swarm sweeps over crops, enemies, and supplies.
mythic_age.spellbook.tornado.description: A roaring desert tornado lifts enemies and tears through the battlefield.
mythic_age.spellbook.isis_resurrection.d: Isis' mercy restores fallen life and returns allies to the fight.
mythic_age.spellbook.meteor.description: Call meteors from the heavens to crash down in devastating fire.
mythic_age.spellbook.tidal_surge.descrip: Atlantean tides crash through the target area, damaging and slowing enemies.
mythic_age.spellbook.abyssal_current.des: Ride a hidden deep current to blink toward the target and gain brief underwater mobility.
mythic_age.spellbook.crystal_barrier.des: Lost crystal wards grant absorption, resistance, and water breathing to nearby allies.
mythic_age.spellbook.pearl_harvest.descr: Recover pearl offerings and prismarine from the sea floor while blessing the caster with luck.
mythic_age.spellbook.orichalcum_forge.de: Ignite an orichalcum forge, empowering gathering and condensing prismarine and metal.
mythic_age.spellbook.siren_song.descript: A siren hymn weakens and disorients enemies while briefly restoring allies.
mythic_age.spellbook.leviathan_call.desc: Call a leviathan-shaped deep-sea apparition that damages, reveals, and pulls enemies inward.
mythic_age.spellbook.abyssal_rift.descri: Open an abyssal rift that pulls enemies inward and wounds them with dark ocean magic.
mythic_age.spellbook.chrono_stasis.descr: Project lost Atlantean stasis technology, nearly freezing enemies in a wide tactical field.
mythic_age.spellbook.oceanic_wrath.descr: Call Atlantean lightning, waves, and shockwaves to overwhelm the battlefield.

Nordic power comes from battle, raids, hunts, and heroic combat pressure.
gui.mythic_age.god_power_guide.acquisiti: Defeat hostile monsters or enemy players to earn Nordic certificates through combat.
Atlantean power combines ocean exploration, crystal technology, and deep-sea spellcraft.
gui.mythic_age.god_power_guide.acquisiti: Explore ocean ruins and maintain Atlantean temple trades to build a stock of certificates.
